title: Automated quant eval harness with drift detection & threshold tuning
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build an automated evaluation harness that validates FP8/INT8 quantization profiles against golden prompt suites and continuous production traffic, with automated drift detection, dynamic threshold tuning, and pass/fail gates. The goal is to catch accuracy regressions introduced by new quant profiles or compilation kernels before they reach Dedicated/Private customers and to provide actionable telemetry for calibration tweaks.
acceptance_criteria: Pipeline runs end-to-end and produces a single pass/fail verdict for a candidate quant profile based on composite metrics
Supports golden prompt suite (current curated set) and sampled production traffic replay with privacy-preserving scrubbers
Implements drift detectors (embedding similarity + token-logprob KL) and raises alerts when drift exceeds configurable thresholds
Auto-tuning knob that explores small calibration shifts (per-layer scale/zero-point heuristics) and reports recommended adjustments
Artifacts (calibration params, metric reports, diffs, failing examples) uploaded to S3 and linked in the CI job
Gates integrate with rollout system: fail blocks canary and trigger automatic fallback to float or previous quant profile
technical_design: The harness is a canonical pipeline composed of independent stages: 1) ingest: golden prompts and sampled production shards are normalized and tokenized; 2) baseline generation: run reference FP16/FP32 model to produce golden outputs and embeddings; 3) quant simulation: run candidate profile using runtime simulation or recorded kernel traces; 4) metric computation: compute per-example exact-match, BLEU/ROUGE-L for structured outputs, embedding cosine similarity (SBERT), and logprob distribution drift (KL divergence across top-k tokens); 5) aggregate: produce composite score with weighted metrics and compute per-bucket pass/fail; 6) tuner: optional local grid search nudging calibration scales and recomputing metrics to find local improvements; 7) gate decision: apply policy rules (absolute thresholds + relative delta tolerances) to produce final verdict. The harness will be implemented as a modular Airflow/Argo workflow with components in Python and Rust for heavy inference paths. Metric code will be unit-tested and mocked to run in CI for quick smoke runs.
testing_plan: Unit tests for metric calculations and normalization rules
Smoke CI job that runs on every quant profile PR using a tiny golden subset
Full evaluation job run nightly on a larger golden set and sampled prod shreds
A/B canary simulation: deploy candidate internally behind canary routing and compare latency/accuracy against baseline
Chaos test: simulate missing KV cache and extreme batch sizes to ensure harness still reports meaningful deltas
